{{Quote|That's amazing! All this time, we've been working from old recordings and the occasional droid when the key to the whole planet's history is right here.|Tiffan Nye|<ref name="The Archive" />}}
'''Tiffan Nye''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was part of a team working on the [[Republic Tarisian Archival Database]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. After her partner [[Wintag]]'s research located the entire government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], alive and in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], Wintag sent messengers to notify Nye in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Olaris]].<ref name="The Archive" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tiffan Nye first appeared in the mission "The Archive" on Taris in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2012]]. The game's dialog files indicate her name was originally "Tiffany Nightsky."
